title: fix(did_verify): strip_did_sig_header corrupts non-UTF-8 bytes
description: strip_did_sig_header in crates/reader/src/post/did_verify.rs uses String::from_utf8_lossy to convert article bytes to a string before splitting on newlines. from_utf8_lossy silently replaces invalid UTF-8 sequences (e.g. Latin-1 bytes in legacy Usenet articles) with U+FFFD (3 bytes: EF BF BD). The reconstructed bytes differ from the original article, so a valid DID signature over the original bytes fails verification. Fix: operate directly on &[u8] using split(|&b| b == b'\n') and eq_ignore_ascii_case on bytes, avoiding any UTF-8 conversion.
